verdict.rationale: Rippling publishes developer docs, a sandbox, an official CLI (rippling-cli with Flux commands), and references to 'development kits' and APIs for building custom apps, plus an llms.txt mentioning npm packages — suggesting some official SDK tooling exists. However there is no explicit, named SDK (e.g., a documented language-specific SDK page with install/quickstart) or independent confirmation of SDK maturity beyond the CLI and API docs. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK documentation/quickstart, multi-language SDK coverage, and independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
